definitions.explanation: An approximate calculation of cost or price for goods or services.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{見積|みつも}りを{取|と}る。
examples.english: Get an estimate for the construction work.

examples.japanese: {見積|みつも}りは{無料|むりょう}です。
{複数|ふくすう}の{会社|かいしゃ}から{見積|みつも}りを{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got quotes from multiple companies.

notes:
{見積|みつも}り comes from the verb {見積|みつも}もる (to estimate).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {見積書|みつもりしょ} (written estimate/quotation)
- {見積|みつも}り{依頼|いらい} (request for quote)
- {概算|がいさん}{見積|みつも}り (rough estimate)
- {相|あい}{見積|みつも}り (comparative quotes)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見積|みつも}りを{取|と}る (to get an estimate)
- {見積|みつも}りを{出|だ}す (to give an estimate)
- {見積|みつも}りを{作成|さくせい}する (to prepare an estimate)
- {見積|みつも}り{金額|きんがく} (estimated amount)

BUSINESS PRACTICE:
{相見積|あいみつも}り (comparing quotes from multiple vendors) is common practice in Japanese business to ensure competitive pricing.
